payload.title: Real-replay and fault-test adaptive live fusion v2 plus universal intake/research-backprop v3
payload.work_clay: Extend the existing non-overlapping V2 real-replay instead of creating a duplicate lane. Replay current repository work events, branch feedback, research receipts and dependency projections through V2 routing plus V3 registered-source intake and mandatory research-backprop. Add SourceCursor coverage/gap detection, IntakeEnvelope normalization, EvidenceAtom novelty/conflict classification, ResearchObligation creation, ResearchBackpropReceipt closure and result re-entry. Compare broadcast, tag-only, V2 adaptive routing and V3 closed-loop fusion under matched inputs. Inject missing dependency edges, stale projection epochs, duplicate deltas, out-of-order causal predecessors, source outage, cursor gaps, conflicting high-quality evidence, stale-primary vs fresh-primary supersession, crash-mid-fusion and restart/replay. Measure stranded material deltas and broken feedback loops explicitly.
payload.reason_clay: The V2 candidate begins after a KnowledgeDelta already exists. Project-owner direction requires live fusion of all newly observable registered-source data and feedback of fused knowledge into research. V3 supplies the missing pre-delta intake and post-fusion research-backprop layers while preserving V2 dependency-aware routing, provenance, anti-entropy and non-promotion controls. Current primary research supports adaptive incremental refresh and current stream-processing practice requires checkpoint/replay plus explicit boundaries around external exactly-once effects.
payload.completion_clay: The combined replay report contains exact repo/commit/epoch hashes and raw metadata rows; registered-source coverage-to-cursor is measured; source gaps/outages are explicit; broadcast/tag-only/V2/V3 are matched; duplicate/out-of-order/stale/missing/conflict/restart faults are executed; anti-entropy permanent-miss rate and repair latency are measured; every material fusion on the declared corpus produces a ResearchObligation or evidence-backed EXPLICIT_NO_CHANGE; stranded_delta_count=0 and broken_feedback_loop_count=0 on the declared corpus; result_reentry_rate is measured; external effects are idempotency/receipt guarded; candidate receives SUPPORTED, REFUTED, REVISE or NO_CHANGE only; no ClayCode BASE PASS credit is granted from representability or synthetic replay alone.
payload.executor_policy: Use the first non-overlapping worker with repository checkout plus local Python/SQLite/ClayGraph capability. Refresh canonical/head and latest work revision before effect. Preserve the BASE ClayCode critical path: do not displace WORK-CLAYCODE-BASE14-CLOSE-20260809 when the same executor is required; run concurrently only with spare capacity or when the replay directly improves work-state/fusion reliability. No paid training. No Frank self-harness authority.
invalidators: A newer owner-fixed live-fusion protocol explicitly supersedes V2/V3
A newer real execution receipt already performs the same combined matched replay and fault matrix
Current repo state proves registered-source cursor semantics materially inapplicable
A concrete BASE critical-path collision leaves no spare execution capacity
